docs.title: Mentoring a Junior Colleague
docs.text: Field Content Date 17 Aug 2026 Activity Mentoring Duration 30 mins Objective Provide constructive career advice Session Focus After learning I would be leaving my R2 role, an R1 colleague reached out for advice. They had been asked if they were interested in being my replacement but gave a non-committal answer. They were waiting on the outcome of another slightly more advanced R1 role and also had interview fatigue after recently losing out for another open R2 position. I advised them to call our manager back, express strong interest in the R2 role, and explain that their hesitation was due to not wanting to turn down the better R1 role if offered. I explained that honesty is the best policy. It is fine to say the R2 role is their priority, while accepting the R1 role in the meantime so they do not risk ending up with neither. Reflection I felt I may have been too forceful and next time will be less concrete "do this" and more "this is an option". However, the colleague ended the call by thanking me for revitalising their enthusiasm and said they would take my advice. Evidence None, informal ad-hoc teams call

docs.title: Create CPD Log
docs.text: Field Content Date 19 Aug 2026 Activity Creating a CPD log Duration 2 hours Objective Design a structured, public CPD record aligned with UK CSC requirements Session Focus Set up a new MkDocs GitHub Pages site. Defined top-level categories (Structured Learning, Reflective Learning, Professional Contribution). Designed a consistent entry template covering date, activity, duration, objective, session focus, reflection and evidence. Refined the format through several iterations to keep it clear, concise and suitable for professional registration evidence. Reflection Building this forced me to think carefully about how CPD evidence should be presented. The process of choosing categories and writing the first entries improved my understanding of what assessors look for. I now have a repeatable system that will make future CPD recording quicker and more consistent. Evidence https://variable190.github.io/cpd/
